violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (steam kettle) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took unit out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the 1 door freezer have an accumulation ice. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2026
Inspector observed leak at pvc pipes under 3 bay sink. Systems must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2024

The dumpster outside is located on (grass). The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2024

Outside refuse area is with an accumulation of trash, litter, and clothes. and/or debris. Outside refuse areas must be kept cleaned as often as neccessary to keep them clean . New Violation. Correct By: 06/19/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the dry food storage area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/17/2024
